name: clawd-git
description: A live git side pane: changed files, diffs, the commit graph and the file tree, in tabs

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the git pane when a session starts (it docks beside the conversation in fullscreen, on a terminal 144 columns or wider).

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane re-reads git while it is shown. It also refreshes right after each file edit or shell command.

icons.title: File icons
icons.description: Show file-type icons in the Files pane. Needs a Nerd Font in your terminal; turn off if you see empty boxes.
